verdict.rationale: BILL's own S&E docs cover setting up budgets, users and virtual cards, including a dedicated recipe for budgets and cards. Marketing says every transaction is 'controlled' and 'automatically compliant,' which implies spend controls but does not document how budget limits are enforced on cards. The approval evidence (custom approval policies, bill approval policies) appears to cover AP bills rather than card or budget spend, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: documented card spending limits tied to budget allocations, team/project-level budget assignment, spend or purchase approvals that enforce budgets, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
